auditor_patel: Hi team  We're preparing the SOC2 evidence packet. We observed an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-881) during a vuln triage for CVE-2026-0555 on 2026-06-12. Request: raw CloudTrail KMS events showing no external key export, a short rollback timeline/note, remediation artifacts (PR + deploy IDs), and any HSM/EKM wrapproofs. Please include presigned paths.

riley-sec: Copy. We'll collect raw CloudTrail + SIEM correlation. Quick Q: prefer raw events only or raw + signed manifest?

auditor_patel: Raw events preferred; manifest+signed hashes are fine as supplemental. If you have an envelope HMAC or HSM wrap log, include that and note verifier key id.

noah-sre: Assembling now. I'll upload to presigned S3: s3://redwood-evidence/1843210000/
Files: cloudtrail_kms_1843210000.json.gz, siem_rbac_alerts_1843210000.log.gz, rb-881-rollback.txt, cve-0555-remediation.md, hsm_wraplog.gz, manifest.sha256.sig

maya-eng: Rollback note (short):
"Reverted rolebinding rb-881 at 2026-06-12T21:07:03Z after canary observed broadened write access to secrets namespace. Revert executed by maya-eng via ops-runbook v3.4. Canary passed at 21:14Z. Ticket: SEC-5099."

riley-sec: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-06-12T21:05:22Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-77" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ab12-cd34" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

riley-sec: HSM/EKM wrap log (excerpt): `HSM: wrap key=ab12-cd34 caller=rbac-agent-77 recipient=local result=OK`. No external wrap peers. We also produced kms-envelope-hmac.b64 at s3://redwood-evidence/1843210000/kms-envelope-hmac.b64, verifier key ck-29. HMAC verification: OK.

compliance-bot: Automated check: manifest.sha256.sig signature valid (compliance key ck-17). Hashes match uploaded artifacts. :white_check_mark:

auditor_patel: Great. Two quick follow-ups: 1) paste the first line of rb-881-rollback.txt inline here; 2) provide the PR link for CVE fix and deploy tags/IDs.

maya-eng: First line: "Revert rb-881 applied 2026-06-12T21:07:03Z by maya-eng. Cause: canary flagged write-scope expansion."

noah-sre: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1589
Deploys: deploy-usw2-20260612-9, rolling-canary-20260612-4

auditor_patel: Thanks. Last check  any PutKeyPolicy / DisableKey / ScheduleKeyDeletion / UpdateKeyDescription events for CMK ab12-cd34 in the 20:30-22:00Z window? If yes include diffs.

riley-sec: Confirmed: no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, or UpdateKeyDescription for key ab12-cd34 between 2026-06-12T20:30Z and 2026-06-12T22:00Z. There is an unrelated key rotation ticket on 2026-05-30.

auditor_patel: Perfect. Please append a one-line mapping in manifest (or paste here) tying artifacts to controls CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2.

maya-eng: Added to manifest-signed.txt: 
- CC6.2: RBAC change and rollback plus KMS/HSM logs demonstrate detection and timely remediation; no evidence of key export.
- ISO A.9.2: Access rights adjusted and emergency rollback executed; HSM wrap logs show local wrapping only.

auditor_patel: Awesome, I'll attach these to the SOC2/ISO packet. If we need signed attestations from HSM ops, I'll request them. Thanks all :thumbsup:
